answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 42587 Country: India Title: Cancer Question: I am suffering from cancer of stomach and now my third chemotherapy is going to be done. After that doctor will operate my ulcer in stomach, please suggest some dua or wazifa for cure of this ailment. Answer ID: 42587 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1706/1706/M=1433) Write surah al-Fatiha and Ayat-e-shifa on Chinese saucer and drink it or read it and blow on you. In-shaAllah, you shall be cured. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
